learning_outcomes.text: To know the basics of energy conversion in energy systems.
To know the types and performances of fluid machines.
To evaluate the performance of energy systems according to the operating parameters.
To choose fluid machines according to the specific application.

syllabus_topics: Thermodynamics of thermal power plants: steam plants, gas turbines and internal combustion engines
Architecture, principles of operation and performance of fluid machines
assessment_rules: The exam is passed if the exercise is correct and the threshold of 4 points in the tests is overcome.
bibliography: Sistemi energetici e macchine a fluido / Giorgio Negri di Montenegro, Michele Bianchi, Antonio Peretto Bologna: Pitagora, 2009
Macchine a fluido / Vincenzo Dossena et al. Torino: Città studi, 2015
Esercitazioni di sistemi energetici / Carlo Carcasci, Bruno Facchini Bologna: Esculapio, 2016
